notes.title: Pathfinder 2 Playtest released in Early Access for FREE as PFRPG2 Ruleset
notes.content:
This is available as a free update for all licensed users. Just run an Update to add the new ruleset and campaign option. We recommend making a new campaign instead of using the Manage Characters options.

The initial release includes the following items:
[H1]PFRPG2 RULESET[/H1]
V3.3.6 (release 1)
This is the initial public Early Access release aimed at bringing basic Pathfinder 2 Playtest functionality to Fantasy Grounds.  Initial functionality includes:

[LIST]
[*]Character tracker to aid character creation and track high-level additions to the PC.
[*]Character sheet with abilities, saves, initiative, skills, attacks and damage.
[*]Equipment bulk tracking.
[*]Armor statistics.
[*]Armor, Weapon and Gear drag/drop functionality.
[*]Critical attack and damage automation.
[*]PC Perception or Stealth Initiative rolling.
[*]Proficiency level and bonus automation for: AC/TAC, Saves, Skills and attacks.
[*]Initial NPC records and:
[*]Rollable Initiative, Saves, Attacks and damage.
[*]AC/TAC targeting and hit/miss indication.
[*]HP tracking.
[*]Skills.
[/LIST]

[B]Underdevelopment (not currently available)[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Spells and powers.
[*]Spell caster classes.
[*]Death/Recovery rolls.
[*]Archetypes.
[*]Resistances, Weaknesses and Immunities automation.
[*]Expanded weapon trait automation.
[*]Hazard records and automation.
[*]Hero Points.
[*]Magic items and resonance.
[*]Affliction records and tracking (diseases, poisons, etc.). 
[*]Expanded Critical success, success, failure and critical failure automation.
[*]Advanced NPC functionality.
[*]Selective initiative rolling – select Perception, Stealth or another skill before rolling.
[*]Effects and conditions.
[*]Expanded PC action records.
[*]Human ethnicities.
[*]Party Sheet.
[*]PC mini sheet.
[/LIST]

[H1]CORE DATA MODULE[/H1]
[LIST]
[*]Classes (all 12 are there)
[*]Character build wizard should work for each but we haven't fully tested each of them
[*]Character Features through level 20 are included for each and picked up with the auto-leveler
[*]Items are loaded
[*]Weapons dragged to inventory add the Attack Actions automatically
[*]Armor dragged to inventory updates the defenses accordingly
[*]Items add to the bulk
[*]Backgrounds are included and used in character building
[*]Ancestries included (all races)
[*]These set base HP, speed, etc.
[*]They add racial features to the character sheet when drag and dropped
[*]Feats
[*]Includes general feats
[*]includes all Ancestry feats
[*]Includes class feats to level 5 for Alchemist, Barbarian, Bard, Cleric, Fighter and Rogue.
[*]Skills are listed in the reference manual. These are marked as Incomplete so we can accomodate Skill actions in the future.
[*]Traits will be added in the next few days
[/LIST]

Video Playlist
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_lvUxB0174E&list=PL3h0dIaiayC-F_ZjQyrlNYSwB4Ck1cSNg

Feedback should be reported here:
https://www.fantasygrounds.com/forums/forumdisplay.php?105-Pathfinder-2-0

notes.title: Massive Price Drop on D&D Modules for Fantasy Grounds
notes.content:
August 15, 2017

There is no better time to stock up on D&D modules for Fantasy Grounds than the present. The new prices just went into effect and are insta-buys for any DMs. Players have a lot to choose from as well.

[b]Running D&D on Fantasy Grounds[/b]
To get started as a DM, you only need a Standard license or subscription of Fantasy Grounds and the D&D adventure you want to run. Check the low prices below. We have every D&D adventure ready to run for the current edition of D&D and a bunch of older D&D Next adventures we converted to D&D fifth edition as well. They come with all the monsters, items and more you need to play right away.

[b]What do players need?[/b]
Players will need their own license or subscription of Fantasy Grounds unless you have the Ultimate license or subscription. Then, they only need the free demo version. They can build characters using the include 5E SRD Data module and the D&D Basic Rules modules. If the character, race or options they want to play is not included in those built-in modules, you can pick up the Complete Core Class Pack, Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide or Volo's Guide to give them more options. 

[b]Independent Players[/b]
If you are a player that wants to build your characters ahead of time and bring them into any game on Fantasy Grounds whether the DM has an Ultimate or a Standard license, then you will want to get your only Standard license or subscription. You can build characters with the same included 5E SRD Data and D&D Basic Rules modules or add whatever packs you need. The Character Customization Pack plus a class pack can get you up and running for less if you don't want to grab the Complete Core Class Pack.

[b]Want to save even more money?[/b]
Check the weekly newsletter for sales on D&D and other products. The Ultimate license, Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide and Complete Dungeon Masters Guide are on sale this week.

Did we mention that the D&D Complete the Set bundle grants an additional 25% off everything in the bundle that you don't already own and also grants a 25% discount on all future releases that get added to the bundle?

The kicker is that you only get that if you are a completionist. It gets you all the player and DM reference modules as well as every single adventure released so far for the current version of D&D.*

notes.title: Version 3.2 Now Available as a Free Update!
notes.content:
For a complete list of updates, see the list below or visit http://www.fantasygrounds.com/filelibrary/patchnotes.html

Top Highlights:
1. Manual dice roll option added, and can be configured per user.
2. Redesign of campaign record list interface.
3. Sidebar campaign record buttons can be turned on/off in Library.
4. Story templates to generate story records from tables.
5. Random encounters to generate encounter records from dice expressions.
6. [5E/4E/PFRPG/3.5E] Auto-equip armor and weapons when added to PC.
...Many other minor features and fixes...

[code]
Version 3.2.0 (2016-11)

[UPDATER] Greatly decreased time necessary to update after initial update.
Added session backup of campaign database XML, triggered once per day.
When dragging link with empty text, a zero is no longer displayed.
When dragging link with name field, the empty value of the name field (if any) will be used instead of being blank.
[CoreRPG+] Manual dice roll option added as per client toggle.
[CoreRPG+] Access to all standard campaign record types added to library.
[CoreRPG+] Sidebar campaign record buttons can be turned on/off in Library.
[CoreRPG+] Campaign lists in sidebar upgraded to some module data as well as campaign data with a filter to display subset by category.
[CoreRPG+] Automatic adjustment of sidebar layout based on number of buttons.
[CoreRPG+] PC creation sidebar view and buttons added in library. Varies by ruleset.
[CoreRPG+] Radial menu option added to entries in Character Selection window on GM side to take ownership in order to hide from PC view.
[CoreRPG+] Radial menu option added to PC desktop portraits to start a whisper.
[CoreRPG+] Support currency prefixes when selling items from the party sheet. (such as $)
[CoreRPG+] Punctuation will be displayed even when scrambling text via the language feature.
[CoreRPG+] Name and load filters added to module activation window.
[CoreRPG+] Table name references can now span modules.
[CoreRPG+] Added /importnpc command (similar to /importchar command but using npc tags for each record, instead of character tags)
[CoreRPG+] When adding NPCs or Encounters to combat tracker which use tokens not loaded, letter tokens will be applied.
[CoreRPG+] When adding NPCs to encounter which use tokens not loaded, letter tokens will be applied.
[CoreRPG+] When dragging links from campaign record lists or entries, the empty display text will be used if no value specified for the name field.
[CoreRPG+] Auto center map on active combatant at start of turn option added.
[CoreRPG+] Story templates added to generate story entries using tables lookups.
[CoreRPG+] Random encounters added to generate encounters with variable numbers of monsters using dice expressions.
[CoreRPG+] "Equipped" state added to the PC inventory items, in addition to "Carried". (Not used in Fate/SW/Numenera)
[CoreRPG+] Removed "Polyglot" as language override, since it is used in some RPG systems.
[5E/4E/PFRPG/3.5E/CnC] Attack roll comparisons versus armor class will show the adjusted total at the beginning of the resolution message.
[5E/4E/PFRPG/3.5E/CnC] XP can be applied to individual characters by dragging a number onto the PC experience field in the party sheet XP tab.
[5E/PFRPG/3.5E/CnC] Random NPC hit point option could return zero or negative hit points. Fixed.
[5E/4E/PFRPG/3.5E] Increased maximum of PC ammo field on weapons to 100, up from 50.
[5E/4E/PFRPG/3.5E] The ability used for all standard skills can be changed.
[5E/4E/PFRPG/3.5E] Attack critical state tracking added for untargeted attack and damage rolls.
[5E/4E/PFRPG/3.5E] Attack critical state tracking added for PCs and NPCs not in combat tracker.
[5E/4E/PFRPG/3.5E] Armor and shields added to inventory will automatically equip if armor and shield not already equipped.
[5E/4E/PFRPG/3.5E] Equipped armor and shields will calculate armor adjustments automatically.
[5E/PFRPG/3.5E/CnC] Weapons will be equipped by default, and will be hidden in the PC Actions tab combat mode or mini window if not equipped.
[5E] Misc action group DC modifier added to PC actions tab group details. (i.e. Robe of the Magi DC boost)
[5E] Default cone angle adjusted.
[5E] Lair actions category added to NPC record powers.
[5E] Initiative checks will now apply modifiers and advantage/disadvantage relevant to any Dexterity check.
[5E] When using average damage option, critical dice will now be rolled, per the DMG rules.
[5E] Multiple damage types in weapon damage field will be parsed to weapon entries when added to PC.
[5E] Racial ability score increase traits will handle racial ability reductions.
[5E] When initial monk or barbarian level added, the unarmored defense secondary ability will be added to armor class details automatically.
[5E] Added Stealth field to armor detail record.
[5E] Spell slots no longer automatically added on spell drops, only on class drops.
[PFRPG/3.5E] For NPCs, Invisible effect added for natural invisibility quality, and CONC effect added for blur quality.
[PFRPG/3.5E] Added targeting support for CLC effects.
[PFRPG/3.5E] All trained-only skill rolls made by untrained PCs will be tagged.
[PFRPG/3.5E] Party sheet skill rolls will be made, even when PC is untrained in a trained-only skill.
[PFRPG/3.5E] Spell DC calculation option added for caster level divided by 2.
[PFRPG/3.5E] CC effect tag supports targeted and conditional options.
[PFRPG] Adjusted parsing of elemental creatures to apply all elemental traits where elemental is noted as creature type or subtype.
[CoC/CnC] Added text labels to sidebar buttons.
[CoC] Language skills are now considered when using the language feature, including partial understanding when less than 50% skill.
[CoC] Top 15 world languages and unknown language option added to new campaigns.
[SW] If NPC added to combat tracker without a valid token, a letter token will be used instead.
[SW] Added auto-apply range modifier option.
[SW] Unskilled entry now added to PC sheet when opened by player.
Client would close unexpectedly if attempting to Manage Characters for a campaign using a ruleset which was not locally installed. Fixed.
Chat entries dragged onto windows overlaying chat window were also echoing drag to chat. Fixed.
Crash condition when using token bag after unloading a token module and a link to a bag in that module was added to the token bag quick bar. Fixed.
Category control re-ordering deprecated to support current and future category features.
Crash could occur if target of an open radial menu deleted by another client and radial menu selection completed. Fixed.

notes.content:
[h1]SALE AT 20% OFF[/h1]

As before, these sales stack with the D&D Complete the Set Bundle, so you actually get 45% off those two items and 25% off everything else you didn't already own in the bundle.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5967781/b966152804d8c83e682f1570d881bd112b45d915.jpg[/img]  [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5967781/692dd511a2f22469e09f0b0cd29687653ff42fd6.jpg[/img]
[b]The D&D Complete Core Monster Pack[/b]
The Complete Core Monster Pack has all the missing monsters from the SRD, along with full descriptions of each monster's backgrounds, images for most of the monsters and pog style tokens for each monster that included a picture. It also has custom decals for use on your FG desktop that you can select and cycle through in your campaign settings. The descriptions add details on the ecology, lairs and regional effects that might surround a monster.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/360115/

[b]D&D Legacy of the Crystal Shard[/b]
For the Legacy of the Crystal Shard, this adventure is targeted towards characters levels 1 through 3 and takes place in the area of Icewind Dale that has been popularized in the R.A. Salvatore books. It gives a shorter introduction adventure and can be run as a complete stand-alone adventure. 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/436250/

[h1]NEW RELEASES[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5967781/eff182a68e621645dddd8068bdc96db395c020bb.jpg[/img]  [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5967781/8335844ebd1b0538c35f676e7011c8defd865d89.jpg[/img]
[b]Rippers Resurrected for Savage Worlds[/b]
Following the highly successful launch of the Rippers Resurrected Kickstarter, we have coordinated with our partner Pinnacle Entertainment Games to bring this to Fantasy Grounds for use as a campaign manager or for playing with your group completely online. All the NPCs, plot points, rippertech, inventory and lodges. It comes with a new custom skin for the Savage Worlds ruleset for Fantasy Grounds and changeable desktop decals and bennie graphics. Furthermore, there are some great features for managing your Reason, Favors, Lodge Points and Advances. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5967781/df6c6dd24b9f4f13cbe251ace56214523b4ab493.png[/img]
[b]What is Rippers Resurrected?[/b]
Rippers is a roleplaying game of gothic supernatural horror, where Victorian era monster hunters--the Rippers--fight the fearsome creatures of the night.

[b]Rippers fight the terrors of the night:[/b] werewolves, vampires, and other horrors that stalk the earth preying on humanity. These foul monsters boast superhuman strength and supernatural powers. The Rippers must use everything at their disposal to resist them. 

Some invest in the [b]latest technology[/b]—incredible devices of iron and steel powered either by steam or, more recently, by electricity. Others practice [b]ancient magic[/b] or perform [b]holy miracles[/b]. A rare few bravely (or foolishly) wield [b]arcane biotechnology “ripped” from the very creatures they hunt.[/b]

Whatever the methods, all are united in their dedication to protect mankind from the monsters that stalk the night. The Rippers’ struggle against evil rages on largely unknown to the wider world.

Video Walkthrough : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KK0kokINHMU

To use it as a GM, you will need an active subscription or 1-time license for Fantasy Grounds, the Savage Worlds Deluxe ruleset and the two modules for Ripper's Resurrected. Player's connecting to a GM running the game will just need an active subscription or 1-time license for Fantasy Grounds. If the GM has an Ultimate license, then the player only needs a Demo license.  The Player's Guide is optional for players who have a license of Fantasy Grounds and who want to read about the all the character options and setting info without being connected to a GM.

Savage Worlds Deluxe Ruleset:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/297940/

Rippers Resurrected: Game Master's Handbook
http://store.steampowered.com/app/472670/

Rippers Resurrected: Player's Guide
http://store.steampowered.com/app/472671/

[h1]New 5E Compatible Adventures[/h1]
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5967781/9a3c78ad8b7ac1a5776d4425f99bbd210b3f54da.jpg[/img]
[b]Into the Feyweald[/b]
Into the Feyweald is an adventure centered around the fairy world. Enjoy the magical, mystical world of faeries, goblins and trolls with this adventure from Legendary Games. It is built for 1st level characters.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/476440

notes.title: New Map Collections from AAW and a Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition Item and Portrait Packs
notes.content:
First up, we have 3 massive map collections spanning cartography produced over 4+ years by Indie RPG publisher AAW Games (AdventureAWeek). Each collection contains more than 50 maps ranging from dungeons or towns to forest paths. They are usable in any ruleset.

Each collection comes with thumbnail browsers that give a quick idea of what the full map looks like. Reveal image pins/shortcuts or hold CTRL to see them and then click on the push pin to open the full map. If the map uses a grid, it will already be set and ready for use.

[img]http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/425180/ss_41f126c30b195fb57a312a768ebef3d9a483abe7.1920x1080.jpg?t=1450205559&alt_url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/425180/ss_41f126c30b195fb57a312a768ebef3d9a483abe7.1920x1080.jpg?t=1450205560[/img]

[h1]Baldur's Gate Meets Fantasy Grounds[/h1]
Did you love playing the Baldur's Gate and Icewind Dale games? We did too. Through a partnership with Beamdog, we can now bring you a set of 4 different portrait packs for use with your characters. It uses the same images and portraits from the popular video games and crops, resizes and packages them into a nice little add-on for Fantasy Grounds users. At only $2 per pack, what are you waiting for?

http://store.steampowered.com/app/425030/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/425060/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/425020/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/425090/

[h1]Item Lore Galore![/h1]
Steep your campaign in the deep Forgotten Realms lore of Baldur's Gate. Don't just include another longsword +1 in your treasure parcel. Instead, fill your loot with magical trinkets, weapon and armor that left an impact on the realms. The party's bard or sage can regale the party with how The Magma Bulwark was forged by the fire giant Varboti and offered as a gift for a Cormyrian general who made peace with his clan.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/428520/

notes.content:

[*]The class description from the Player's Handbook for all 4 basic core classes: cleric, fighter, rogue and wizard 
[*]Details and features from levels 1-20 for the 4 included classes 
[*]Automatic addition of new class features when you drag the class link to your character's level summary
[/LIST]

notes.title: Now available for Mac - plus additional DLC and the Ultimate Upgrade
notes.content:
[h1]Now available for Mac Users[/h1]
Mac users can now try out the Demo and activate or purchase a Full version of Fantasy Grounds. They can play cross-platform with users on Windows or Mac/Linux/PC users running outside of Steam. It took almost an enitre day, at least 6 cups of coffee and lots of help from Zeus to pull it off, but the simpler installation works fairly well. 
[i]* Zeus is one of the forum users and regular community contributors for Fantasy Grounds and not "the" Zeus from the Greek Pantheon. [/i]

[h1]The Ultimate Upgrade is available[/h1]
Originally, we weren't sure we'd be able to provide the Ultimate license for Fantasy Grounds on Steam. Now it is available as an Upgrade and is currently 25% off for the launch week. The Ultimate functions exactly like the regular version on Steam but with one major difference.  If you host a game with an Ultimate license, you can have regular users [b]and[/b] Demo users join your campaigns. They will be treated just like regularly licensed players when they connect. This means that you can run as many campaigns as you want with as many of your friends as you'd like and they don't ever have to buy anything. 

[h1]Chaosium's Basic Roleplaying (BRP) System is now available[/h1]
Check out BRP and find out why Chaosium's systems are so popular. The ease of understanding with a percentile based system can not be overstated. There is no easier way for players to wrap their head around having a 65% chance at success -- than having a skill with a 65% success attached to it. Oh yeah, it's also 25% off for the launch week.

[h1]Rolemaster Classic Ruleset is now available[/h1]
RMC, as it is known, is one of the crunchiest (is that a word) systems there are. There are sophisticated tables available for nearly every type of attack. The learning curve is a little steeper for this ruleset than for any others, however, the RMC community on FG swears by it as a way to play the game much more quickly than it would be in paper. The automation of chart lookups during combat allows for much faster play without losing any of the complexity that players love. One GM recently ran a 4-hour session for FG Con and was able to complete 5 separate battles in that time period. For those familiar with RMC, you will realize how impressive that is. 

Hey, guess what. It is 25% off during launch week.

[h1]Fiery Dragon Token Pack now available[/h1]
Fiery Dragon have been long time supporters of Fantasy Grounds, and it seemed only appropriate that we make one of their token packs the first ones available. The artwork is cropped profiles and are very beautifully drawn.  The first set was built to cover many of the monsters and creatures you may come up against in a D&D 4E game; however, they are suitable for any fantasy setting and come marked as such. You can use these same tokens in Castles & Crusades, Savage Worlds, Rolemaster Classic or even in one of the community rulesets. 

Did I mention that they are 25% for launch week?
